title: Design System: FORGE Semester Desk v2

display.purpose: Use Geist only at a public entry or a major transition.

body.purpose: Use Geist for course facts, recovery choices, learning work, and controls.

reflection.purpose: Use Libre Baskerville only for a short learner question or reflection.

native.purpose: Use Dynamic Type and the system font in the iOS application.

motion.name: threshold-entry
motion.purpose: Support one entry or return transition.

components.name: Navigation Action
components.description: A cobalt action that opens another product surface.
components.css: .ds-navigation-action { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #123EAE; border-radius: 6px; background: #123EAE; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 18px; font: 800 16px/1.2 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-navigation-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2A61D8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Learner Commitment
components.description: The one orange action that records a deliberate student choice.
components.css: .ds-learner-commitment { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #B73F22; border-radius: 6px; background: #F0643B; color: #102019; padding: 12px 18px; font: 800 16px/1.2 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-learner-commitment:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2A61D8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Course Status
components.description: A plain sentence with a reason and an available action.
components.html: Needs review. Two copied sources give different dates.
components.css: .ds-status { border-left: 3px solid #F0643B; color: #102019; margin: 0; padding-left: 12px; font: 600 16px/1.5 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Ledger Section
components.description: A flat work group that uses spacing and one divider.
components.html:
Your semester

See every course and every visible change.
components.css: .ds-ledger { border-top: 1px solid #CDD9D0; background: transparent; padding: 24px 0; } .ds-ledger h2 { margin: 0; color: #102019; font: 800 28px/1.1 Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A private and calm university operating system. It is vivid at thresholds and quiet during work.
keyCharacteristics: One honest action at a time
Exact hierarchy with flat work surfaces
Warm ivory, forest, cobalt, and scarce learner orange
Scenery only at a real entry, return, or major transition
Human course-state language with visible reasons

rules.name: Vivid at thresholds
rules.body: Use compact terrain art only for onboarding, recovery confirmation, and delayed return.

rules.name: Quiet during work
rules.body: Use clean Field and Ledger surfaces for courses, capacity, study, proof, and progress.

rules.name: One color, one meaning
rules.body: Use cobalt for navigation, orange for student commitment, and green for checked evidence.

rules.name: No card soup
rules.body: Use spacing and dividers before containers. Use a card only for one bounded decision.

dos: Show the whole semester before one selected action.
Show each changed item before confirmation.
Keep learner text private and preserve context.
Use native iOS navigation, alerts, controls, and Dynamic Type.
Use Checked, Needs review, Your choice, Changed since last check, Not yet confirmed, Ready to work on, and Come back on this date.
donts: Do not use a chatbot-first layout.
Do not use purple-blue AI gradients or unnecessary glass.
Do not use cards as the default container.
Do not use learner orange for navigation.
Do not show internal evidence or protocol terms to a student.
Do not infer mastery, urgency, or institutional truth.
